acceptance: Red test first: a cell of one CLI family cannot write the state dir of another family (a sandbox-exec contract row for each pair of claude, codex and agy).
A cell still writes its own state dir: a contract row proves the write of the own dir.
100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Pass the CLI of the cell to homeStateWriteDirs and grant file-write* only for the state dirs that the manifest home_reads of that CLI names, plus the shared .cache and .config dirs. Derive the dirs from manifest data, not from a driver list in the sandbox adapter.
summary: homeStateWriteDirs grants file-write* on ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.gemini, ~/.cache and ~/.config to a cell of any CLI. A claude cell can write the state of the codex and agy CLIs. AD1-6 denies the write of each listed secret path, but not of the other files in these dirs.
title: Scope the home state write dirs of a cell to its own CLI
